entry.name: Chromium (Alpine package)
entry.verified: Alpine package installed with 'apk add --usermode --root ~/ibbrowsers/root --initdb' from the distro repos; apk verifies the RSA-signed APKINDEX and each package's hash against /etc/apk/keys
entry.notes:
driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/root/usr/lib[,pulseaudio,firefox], FONTCONFIG_FILE, ICU_DATA) then execs the driver; binaries run on the system musl loader (same musl as the root). The VM's sshd has 'AllowTcpForwarding no', so ssh -L is refused ('administratively prohibited'); reach the driver with a stdio tunnel instead, e.g. one `ssh x@10.0.1.200 nc 127.0.0.1

` per connection (busybox nc) -- that is how the smoke ran. --disable-gpu-sandbox is required: the GPU process is killed by seccomp-bpf on syscall 0x148 (pwritev2); renderer sandbox stays on. Vendor glibc builds (CfT, Mozilla tarball) don't run on musl.
